a_kcs_fn026_band8.reason: no admissible wave leg: the parametric KCS plan measures Cb=0.645 and Cwp=0.791 (real KCS 0.667), both outside the thin-ship gate, so no C_T is emitted at any Fn
a_kcs_fn026_band8.note: the diagnostic thin-ship C_W is compared with the measured residual C_R = C_T - (1+k)C_F in the report; a 20x over-prediction is the geometry attribution, not a tunable offset

b_dtmb5415_fn028_band10.reason: first-order thin-ship over-predicts the hump; see decomposition

c_series60_cb070_fn03_band10.reason: no first-hand Cb=0.70 reference in refs_lock (ct_ref = null); the parametric family is also outside the thin-ship gate (Cb=0.70 > 0.60)

d_grid_convergence_gci_below_8.requirement: quadrature GCI of the wave leg < 8%
d_grid_convergence_gci_below_8.reason: GCI is defined only where the wave leg is admitted; the parametric hulls have no admissible wave solve, which is itself the finding

f_ct_monotone_in_fn.reason: only admitted hulls with a fully converged ladder can be tested; a non-converged wave level withholds that Fn instead of fabricating a point

g_pending_to_verified.reason: criteria (a)-(c) are not met; the case stays in benchmarks/pending/ with a documented blocker -- promoting it would be an unearned promotion

h_pytest_green.note: count recorded by the runner from the last local run of the file

lbm_leg.reason: no free-surface/VOSET lattice run reaches model Reynolds number with a wall law in this repository; the resolution-Re friction leg delivered Ct_fric/ITTC ~ 2.5 (benchmarks/pending/suboff_highre_resistance), so a lattice total-resistance claim at model scale would be an unearned promotion
evidence: benchmarks/pending/dtmb5415_resistance (exp C_T not comparable, -22.4% no-wave floor)

verdict.headline: geometry audit + closure identity + quadrature verification pass; model-scale C_T agreement does not
